title: Transfers rows take CPU jobs too (ffmpeg, file copy, cleanup), with the moving sweep when there is no %
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1102 - No silent work: every job shows in the queue (umbrella) (consolidation sweep 2026-10-12). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-1102/plan.md. Fabio 2026-10-12: nothing new - reuse what exists. Transfers in MpiQueuePanel (MPI-1057, _transfers / _renderTransfers) lists state.downloadJobs / state.uploadJobs, each row already an MpiProgressBar. Add one more row kind for a CPU job (ffmpeg, sharp, a file copy, a cleanup) to that same list. No real % = toggle the existing mpi-progress--loading class on that bar (the same moving sweep MpiInstalledDisplay uses, MPI-95, and the status bar's sb-indeterminate, MPI-147). No new component, no new animation. Row leaves on done / failed / cancelled like a download. Every other member that moves a non-GPU action into the queue depends on this. Never the status bar: that is GPU only.
